name: All Activity Report
query:
SELECT
    c.creation AS "Activity Date:Datetime:160",
    COALESCE(c.comment_by, c.owner) AS "User:Data:180",
    c.comment_type AS "Activity Type:Data:140",
    c.reference_doctype AS "Reference DocType:Data:180",
    c.reference_name AS "Reference Name:Data:180",
    c.content AS "Description:Text:300"
FROM `tabComment` c

UNION ALL

SELECT
    al.communication_date AS "Activity Date:Datetime:160",
    COALESCE(al.user, al.owner) AS "User:Data:180",
    CONCAT_WS(' - ', al.operation, al.status) AS "Activity Type:Data:140",
    al.reference_doctype AS "Reference DocType:Data:180",
    al.reference_name AS "Reference Name:Data:180",
    COALESCE(al.subject, al.content) AS "Description:Text:300"
FROM `tabActivity Log` al

UNION ALL

SELECT
    f.creation AS "Activity Date:Datetime:160",
    f.owner AS "User:Data:180",
    'File Upload' AS "Activity Type:Data:140",
    f.attached_to_doctype AS "Reference DocType:Data:180",
    f.attached_to_name AS "Reference Name:Data:180",
    f.file_name AS "Description:Text:300"
FROM `tabFile` f

UNION ALL

SELECT
    v.creation AS "Activity Date:Datetime:160",
    v.owner AS "User:Data:180",
    'Document Updated' AS "Activity Type:Data:140",
    v.ref_doctype AS "Reference DocType:Data:180",
    v.docname AS "Reference Name:Data:180",
    CONCAT('Document version: ', v.name) AS "Description:Text:300"
FROM `tabVersion` v

ORDER BY 1 DESC
